analysis.summary: Kernex Microsystems reported its Q1 FY2026-27 performance overview alongside details regarding its order book, manufacturing capabilities, and strategic business diversification roadmap. Management highlighted robust financial results including a standalone net revenue of ₹502.03 Crores and a profit after tax of ₹109.57 Crores for the quarter. The company outlined its active execution of Kavach 4.0 projects, expanding working capital facilities, and a growing market pipeline spanning Indian Railways and international opportunities. Additionally, management detailed a diversification strategy into new tech-driven infrastructure segments such as yard management, digital twins, and intelligent traffic systems. Kernex Microsystems presented its financial and operational performance for Q3 and 9M FY25, reporting significant year-on-year revenue growth and positive EBITDA and PAT margins.

guidance.claim: The company expects the entire Indian Railway Network TCAS project to be completed by 2030 to 2032.
The company projected Kavach revenue of 120 Cr in FY23-24, 500 Cr in FY24-25, 1000 Cr in FY25-26, and 1200 Cr in FY26-27.
